tapAbsent: Tap the children who are absent

voice.hold: Hold to say what you taught
voice.noMic: The microphone isn't allowed. Allow it in the browser's settings, or pick the concept below.
voice.holdDown: Hold the button down while you speak.
voice.couldNotRead: Couldn't read the note: {{error}}. Pick the concept below.
voice.checkBelow: Check the concept below, and change it if it's wrong.
voice.nothingHeard: Couldn't hear anything. Hold the phone closer and try again, or pick the concept below.
voice.savedOffline: No signal: the note is saved, and will be read when the phone is back online. You can pick the concept now.
